Microsoft's gross margin for FY2024 and FY2023 can be calculated from the revenue and cost of revenue figures provided, as both periods use the same fiscal-year basis (year ended June 30) and are directly comparable.

**FY2024 Gross Margin:**
Gross profit = $245,122M − $74,114M = $171,008M
Gross margin = $171,008M / $245,122M = 69.76%
[DOC-1: "FY2024 (year ended June 30, 2024): revenue $245,122M, cost of revenue $74,114M."]

**FY2023 Gross Margin:**
Gross profit = $211,915M − $65,863M = $146,052M
Gross margin = $146,052M / $211,915M = 68.92%
[DOC-1: "FY2023 (year ended June 30, 2023, comparative): revenue $211,915M, cost of revenue $65,863M."]

**Change in Gross Margin:**
69.76% − 68.92% = 0.84 percentage points

Microsoft's gross margin improved from FY2023 to FY2024.

ANSWER: Gross margin improved by approximately 0.84 percentage points, from 68.92% in FY2023 to 69.76% in FY2024.
